title: compaction-optimizer settings
description: Schema for extensionSettings.compactionOptimizer.* in ~/.pi/agent/settings.json (user) and <cwd>/.pi/settings.json (project). Documentation-only — pi v0.75.5 does not run runtime schema validation. Numeric bounds below mirror the project-layer runtime clamps in lib/settings.ts (PROJECT_LAYER_CLAMPS); the user layer is not runtime-clamped but operators should treat these bounds as the recommended envelope. See ADR-0019 and #210.

mode.description: Summary generation mode. `hybrid` (default) runs the deterministic LLM-free builder when the conversation is tool-call-dense and falls through to pi's LLM summarizer otherwise. `deterministic` always runs the builder (drops /compact custom instructions with a warning). `llm-only-with-dump` never runs the builder — pi's default summarizer + archive only.

maxTokens.description: Absolute floor of the too-many-tokens gate; the sole gate when the active model's context window is unknown. The effective ceiling is max(maxTokens, maxTokensFraction × contextWindow). See ADR-0107.

maxTokensFraction.description: Context-window-relative token gate (#244, ADR-0107): with a known context window, the too-many-tokens fall-through fires only when tokensBefore exceeds max(maxTokens, maxTokensFraction × contextWindow). Default 1.0 lets ordinary threshold compactions (~0.9 × contextWindow) take the deterministic path on every model.

maxOutputTokens.description: Output-side token budget for the deterministic builder (#254, ADR-0108). The summary is re-built at progressively lower fidelity rungs (drop file activity → tool activity → verdict briefs → turn prefix → carried-forward → trimmed turns → stub) until it fits. Always-on; in hybrid mode an over-budget stub falls through to pi's LLM summarizer, in deterministic mode the stub is emitted anyway with a warning (air-gap preserved).

previousSummaryMaxChars.description: Cap on chars of the prior summary re-inlined into the deterministic builder's Carried-Forward Context section. 0 omits the section entirely; the full prior summary always remains in the archive. Bounds geometric growth across compactions (#253).

maxReadFiles.description: Cap on the size of preparation.fileOps.read after pruning. Excess entries are evicted in insertion order, keeping the most recent N. modifiedFiles is never pruned.

dropPatterns.description: Regex patterns; matching paths are dropped from fileOps.read before the cap is applied. modifiedFiles is unaffected. User layer only — project-layer values are rejected with a notify warning (regex ReDoS surface; see ADR-0019 Threat Model).

timing.description: Compaction when-policy (#677, ADR-0109): defer mid-phase threshold compactions and trigger proactively at phase boundaries on prefix-cached local hosts. USER LAYER ONLY — every timing.* key is project-layer rejected (ADR-0094 trust posture for local-LLM levers). Off by default.

providers.description: Providers the policy applies to. The deferral band only exists where reserveTokens exceeds (1 − deferCeilingFraction) × contextWindow — ~3.3K tokens on a 131K-window local model, none at ≥164K windows with defaults.

deferCeilingFraction.description: At or above this fraction of the context window a threshold compaction is never deferred. Mirrors FORCE_COMPACT_AT in shared/signals.ts.

proactiveAtFraction.description: Usage fraction at which a fresh task-type boundary (agent settled, no fan-out in flight) may trigger a proactive ctx.compact().

boundaryWindowTurns.description: A task-type transition within this many turns counts as 'at a boundary' (never defer; proactive may fire).

events.description: Per-compaction metrics ledger (#838, ADR-0117): one JSONL record per committed compaction, appended to ~/.pi/agent/extensions/compaction-optimizer/events.jsonl. Observational only — never influences dispatch, never blocks a compaction on write failure. Report via scripts/compaction-metrics.sh.

path.description: Absolute or ~-rooted directory where per-session archives are written. User layer only — project-layer values are rejected with a notify warning per ADR-0019 Threat Model.

ephemeralBehavior.description: Behavior for sessions where sessionManager.isPersisted() === false. 'tmp' uses mkdtemp under $TMPDIR with mode 0o700, swept after 24h. User layer only.

redactPatterns.description: Regex patterns applied to archive content before write; matches replaced with [REDACTED]. Best-effort: each pattern runs under a 250ms wall-clock budget. User layer only.
